Prediction-Powered Generalized Linear Model (PPI / PPI++ / Calibrated)

Source: R/ppi_models.R
ppi_glm.Rd

Fits an error-corrected canonical-link GLM (gaussian, binomial, or poisson) combining a human-validated subset with a larger LLM-coded unlabeled corpus via Angelopoulos et al. (2024) M-estimation PPI/PPI++ or coordinate-wise control-variate calibration.

Usage

ppi_glm(
  formula,
  data,
  pred_col,
  family = stats::binomial(),
  unlabeled = NULL,
  method = c("ppi++", "ppi", "calibrated"),
  lambda = NULL,
  conf_level = 0.95,
  max_iter = 60L,
  tol = 1e-09
)

Arguments

formula

Two-sided model formula y ~ x1 + x2.

data

A data.frame containing the response, predictors, and LLM prediction column. When unlabeled = NULL, rows with missing response form the unlabeled set.

pred_col

Name of the LLM prediction column (numeric; for binomial models may be binary {0, 1} or predicted probabilities in [0, 1]).

family

Canonical GLM family: gaussian(), binomial(), or poisson() (or matching string name). Default stats::binomial().

unlabeled

Optional separate data.frame of unlabeled observations.

method

Estimation method: "ppi++" (default, optimal power-tuning \(\hat{\lambda}^* \in [0, 1]\)), "ppi" (lambda = 1), or "calibrated" (coordinate-wise influence-function calibration).

lambda

Optional numeric override for scalar lambda in [0, 1].

conf_level

Confidence level in (0, 1). Default 0.95.

max_iter

Maximum Newton-Raphson iterations. Default 60L.

tol

Convergence tolerance for gradient/step norm. Default 1e-9.

Value

An S3 object of class c("llm_ppi_glm", "llm_ppi").

Examples

set.seed(7)
n_tot <- 800
x <- rnorm(n_tot)
p_true <- plogis(-0.3 + 1.1 * x)
y_true <- rbinom(n_tot, 1, p_true)
y_llm <- plogis(-0.3 + 1.1 * x + 0.7 + rnorm(n_tot, sd = 0.6))
df <- tibble::tibble(
  x = x,
  human_y = c(y_true[1:150], rep(NA_real_, n_tot - 150)),
  llm_prob = y_llm
)
fit <- ppi_glm(human_y ~ x, data = df, pred_col = "llm_prob", family = binomial())
fit
#> 
#> ── Prediction-Powered Inference (ppi++) 
#> Labeled n = 150 | Unlabeled N = 650 | lambda = 0.162 | CI = 95%
#> # A tibble: 2 × 7
#>   term        estimate std_error conf_low conf_high p_value var_gain
#>   <chr>          <dbl>     <dbl>    <dbl>     <dbl> <chr>      <dbl>
#> 1 (Intercept)   -0.253     0.186   -0.619     0.112 0.1748      1.02
#> 2 x              1.06      0.228    0.612     1.51  <0.0001     1.06
